title: LatentRiskBench: Measuring State-Dependent Risks in Enterprise Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.17685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enterprise agents face safety risks that cannot be determined from individual actions alone. Existing safety benchmarks largely evaluate action-local risks, overlooking failures whose safety depends on workflow state. In such state-dependent risks, the same action may be safe in one context but violate policy in another. Hence, we introduce LatentRiskBench for evaluating such state-dependent risks in enterprise settings. It pairs risky trajectories with benign counterparts that share the same terminal action but differ in latent policy-relevant states, requiring models to reconstruct workflow context rather than rely on action-level cues. We also introduce new metrics for state-dependent risk evaluation, including a suite of residual risk (RR) measures. translated_title: LatentRiskBench：度量企业智能体中的状态依赖风险
translated_abstract: 企业智能体面临的安全风险无法仅从单个动作来判断。现有安全基准大多评估动作局部风险，忽视了那些安全性取决于工作流状态的失效情况。在这类状态依赖风险中，同一个动作在一种情境下可能是安全的，但在另一种情境下却违反策略。为此，我们提出了LatentRiskBench，用于评估企业场景中的这类状态依赖风险。该基准将风险轨迹与良性轨迹配对，二者共享相同的最终动作，但在潜在的政策相关状态上存在差异，从而要求模型重建工作流上下文，而非依赖动作层面的线索。我们还引入了用于状态依赖风险评估的新指标，包括一套残余风险（RR）度量。基准上的实验表明，动作级评估仅能检测出0.09的状态依赖违规，而状态级评估可达0.96。现有防护栏方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了LatentRiskBench基准，用于评估企业智能体中无法仅凭单个动作判断的状态依赖安全风险，实验显示动作级评估仅能检测出9%的此类违规，而状态级评估可达96%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LatentRiskBench, a benchmark for evaluating state-dependent safety risks in enterprise agents, showing that action-level evaluation detects only 9% of such violations while state-level evaluation reaches 96%.
